Network

Network and fault-injection test matrix

These are executable test recipes for the future implementation; no multiplayer tests were run during documentation generation.

On this page
ProfilesCaptureStop conditions

Profiles

ProfileSetupExpected invariant
Local baselineDedicated server +2 separate clients, no impairmentOne pawn each; correct authoritative state
Latency100ms and200ms RTT measured, not assumed knob valuesPrediction corrects; UI pending not duplicate grant
Jitter/lossVariable delay and2% loss, actual settings recordedProperty state converges; lost cosmetic events harmless
Bandwidth boundApply measured client/server bandwidth limitsNo hidden reliable-RPC flood; operation status remains understandable
Contention2clients same node/vendor slot/trade acceptanceExactly one exclusive claim/finite stock winner; atomic settlement
Crash boundariesBefore/after commit, transfer redeem, arrival ackDurable receipts survive; old epoch cannot write
Restart/restoreZone restart and isolated restored DBNo duplicate rewards; tested recovery policy and version gate
Scale steps4/8/16/32 only as actually run with representative actorsReport measured p95/p99 and bottleneck, not extrapolated MMO claims

Capture

Record server/client build IDs, hardware, actor populations, tick rates, network emulation settings, operation IDs and database assertions. Turn on needed development diagnostics only. Compare a replicated node/attribute snapshot at late join with expected authoritative state, not only the animation observed by an existing client.

Stop conditions

Any dual active character writer, inventory duplication, lost acknowledged craft result, client price authority, cross-zone reward replay or both players following one individual gate blocks release. Visual defects and performance issues remain defects even when the transaction invariant holds.

Evidence and external references

External links need internet; the manual itself remains offline. Public documentation does not prove installed compatibility.

  • Networking overview — Public 5.8 documentation checked; actor/RPC replication is not automatic replication of all game logic.
  • Networked Character Movement — Public 5.8 description checked: saved moves, server corrections and simulated proxy smoothing. Custom sprint/dodge integration still requires installed-source and runtime verification.
  • Migrate to Iris — Official 5.8 Migrate to Iris page checked on 2026-10-09: Experimental notice; Iris and Replication Graph cannot be used by the same network driver. No runtime adoption test performed.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
